# Practical Publication Workflow

In 2026, a canonical manuscript can reduce duplicated editorial work when DOCX, PDF, and HTML are treated as derived outputs rather than separate sources of truth [1].

The publication should preserve claim scope, citations, protected facts, and format lineage through every substantial edit.
